request.description:
Upload multiple images or videos directly with live progress tracking.

LIFECYCLE:
1. Incoming files are initially created with status: 'temporary'.
2. Once verified and written to disk, status transitions to 'active'.
3. The cleanup worker ONLY deletes files where status remains 'temporary' after 7 days; 'active' files are NEVER deleted.

RESPONSE FORMAT:
{
  "success": true,
  "uploadId": "...",
  "images": [ "http://localhost:5000/uploads/..." ],
  "videos": [ "http://localhost:5000/uploads/..." ],
  "imageRecords": [
    {
      "imageId": "<mongodb_id>",
      "url": "http://localhost:5000/uploads/...",
      "fileName": "...",
      "status": "active"
    }
  ],
  "videoRecords": [
    {
      "videoId": "<mongodb_id>",
      "url": "http://localhost:5000/uploads/...",
      "fileName": "...",
      "status": "active"
    }
  ]
}

Use returned imageId or videoId values in createProduct or updateProduct: images: [{ "imageId": "..." }] / videos: [{ "imageId": "..." }].
